Container.Name: Countertop
Container.Overview: Countertop is a free, self-hosted kitchen dashboard for the Echo Show 15 and other browser displays. Customize your calendar, weather, grocery list, sports, photos, and more. Click WebUI to open Controls. On your display, open the same server address with /dash instead of /control. Use /list for the shared grocery list. Keep Countertop on your trusted home network.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: echo show alexa silk kitchen dashboard family calendar grocery smart display wall tablet selfhosted
